import os

import requests
from flask import Blueprint, jsonify, request

bp = Blueprint('items', __name__)

UPSTREAM_URL = 'https://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/weather'


@bp.get('/api/weather')
def get_item():
    city = request.args.get('city', '').strip()
    if not city:
        return jsonify({'error': 'city is required'}), 400

    api_key = os.environ.get('OPENWEATHER_API_KEY')
    if not api_key:
        return jsonify({'error': 'OPENWEATHER_API_KEY not set'}), 500

    params = {
        'q': city,
        'appid': api_key,
        'units': 'imperial'
    }

    try:
        upstream = requests.get(UPSTREAM_URL, params=params, timeout=5)
    except requests.RequestException:
        return jsonify({'error': 'weather service unavailable'}), 502

    if upstream.status_code == 404:
        return jsonify({'error': 'city not found'}), 404
    if upstream.status_code != 200:
        return jsonify({'error': 'weather service unavailable'}), 502

    data = upstream.json()
    try:
        city_name = data['name']
        temp_f = data['main']['temp']
        description = data['weather'][0]['description']
        return jsonify({'city': city_name, 'temp_f': temp_f, 'description': description}), 200
    except KeyError:
        return jsonify({'error': 'weather service unavailable'}), 502


@bp.get('/')
def index():
    initial_city = "New York"
    page = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Weather</title></head>
<body >
  <h1>Weather lookup</h1>
  <input id="city" type="text" value="{initial_city}">
  <button id="go">Get weather</button>
  <div id="result"></div>
  <script>
    async function lookUp() {{
      const city = document.getElementById('city').value.trim();
      const result = document.getElementById('result');
      if (!city) {{
        result.textContent = 'City name is required';
        return;
      }}
      try {{
        const res = await fetch('/api/weather?city=' + encodeURIComponent(city));
        const data = await res.json();
        if (res.ok) {{
          result.innerHTML = `<strong>${data.city}</strong>: ${Math.round(data.temp_f)}&deg;F, ${data.description}`;
        }} else if (res.status === 404) {{
          result.textContent = 'City not found';
        }} else if (res.status === 400) {{
            result.textContent = data.error || 'City name is required';
        }} else {{
          result.textContent = data.error || 'An unknown error occurred';
        }}
      }} catch (e) {{
        result.textContent = 'Could not connect to the weather service.';
      }}
    }}
    document.getElementById('go').addEventListener('click', lookUp);
    lookUp();
  </script>
</body >
</html>
"""
    return page

PAGE = """<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Items</title></head>
<body>
  <h1>Item lookup</h1>
  <input id="name" type="text" value="Widget">
  <button id="go">Look up</button>
  <div id="result"></div>
  <script>
    async function lookUp() {
      const name = document.getElementById('name').value.trim();
      const result = document.getElementById('result');
      const res = await fetch('/api/items?name=' + encodeURIComponent(name));
      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) {
        result.textContent = data.name + ': ' + data.price;
      } else if (res.status === 404) {
        result.textContent = 'Item not found';
      } else {
        result.textContent = data.error;
      }
    }
    document.getElementById('go').addEventListener('click', lookUp);
    lookUp();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
"""
